titulo: Why Is This Antarctic Glacier Bleeding Red?
tema: Why does a glacier in Antarctica pour a red waterfall onto the ice (Blood Falls, Taylor Glacier)?
estilo_visual: award-winning photorealistic nature photography, cold natural daylight, muted polar colors, shallow depth of field, sharp focus

audio.como_ler: picos_cortados.trechos > 0 = distorção; silencios = buraco de 0,7 s ou mais no meio do vídeo; saltos_volume = volume muda 6 LU ou mais em 1 s; voz_abafada = trecho em que a música (ou ruído) preenche os vãos da fala (heurística: confirme pela transcrição)

cenas.narracao: A glacier in Antarctica is bleeding. A dark red stream pours out of the white ice.
cenas.quadro: A tall white ice cliff of an Antarctic glacier with a dark rust-red stain streaming down its face onto a frozen white lake, bare brown rocky valley slopes behind, pale grey polar sky, medium shot from the frozen lake

cenas.narracao: Explorers found it over a century ago. They blamed red algae, and the name Blood Falls stuck.
cenas.quadro: The same tall white ice cliff of an Antarctic glacier with a dark rust-red stain streaming down its face onto a frozen white lake, seen from slightly to the left, bare brown rocky valley slopes behind, pale grey polar sky, medium shot

cenas.narracao: But there is no algae. Deep under the glacier hides a lake of extremely salty water.
cenas.quadro: Thick layered glacier ice in blue and white bands at the base of an Antarctic ice cliff, a deep blue crack running into the ice, a thin rust-red stain at the bottom edge, bare brown rocks beside it, medium shot
cenas.movimento: slow push-in toward the blue crack

cenas.narracao: That water is so salty it stays liquid in deep cold. Sunlight has not touched it for ages.
cenas.quadro: A small pool of dark still water at the foot of a white Antarctic ice wall, its edges crusted with white frost crystals, frozen white lake ice around it, soft grey polar light, medium shot

cenas.narracao: And it is full of iron. The water comes out clear, then turns red when it touches air.
cenas.quadro: A small trickle of clear water flowing out from the base of a white Antarctic ice wall, the wet ice below it stained bright rust orange and dark red, frozen white lake surface in the foreground, medium shot

cenas.narracao: Stranger still, tiny microbes live in that dark water. They survive with no light and little oxygen.
cenas.quadro: A shallow channel of dark rust-red water running across white Antarctic lake ice, glassy wet surface, faint blue light glowing through the thick ice wall above it, medium shot
cenas.movimento: water flows gently along the channel

cenas.narracao: So the glacier is not bleeding blood. It is bleeding rust, from a hidden world under the ice.
cenas.quadro: The same tall white ice cliff of an Antarctic glacier with a dark rust-red stain streaming down its face onto a frozen white lake, bare brown rocky valley slopes behind, pale grey polar sky, medium shot from the frozen lake
